avis.titre: Fantastic retinol cream...but it's not cruelty-fre
avis.texte: I have really enjoyed using this retinol cream. I started off using it every other night until I was sure my skin could tolerate it more frequently. Now I use it virtually every night as part of my skincare routine before bed. It's very easy to use, and the tube format with the pointed dispensing tip keeps the product inside from contamination and maintains its consistency and integrity. It also easily dispenses just enough to cover my wrinkled areas (forehead, elevens, marionette lines, etc.) rather than my whole face, giving me more bang for my buck. As a cream, it feels good on my face and hasn't irritated my sensitive skin. It's probably still too early to really see any obvious visible effects, but there certainly hasn't been any inflammation or other bad side effects from using it. My only complaint about this product is that, while La Roche-Posay says they never test their products on animals, they do sell their products in countries like China, where animal testing is mandated. Even if they don't test on animals, they have to pay some third party to do it, so their products are definitely NOT cruelty-free. That is just not acceptable to me, so unfortunately, I cannot recommend this product to anybody until it is truly 100% cruelty-free. I will use this tube until it's gone, but I won't purchase it again.

The texture is light and creamy just as advertised, and it feels heavenly going on my face. It is not greasy, and keeps my face moisturized all night. It has improved the size of the pores on my nose in the two weeks that I have been using it. They are hardly noticeable anymore. (yay!) It has helped with the small lines around my upper lip, and my over all complexion is better. I haven't noticed much improvement in the fine lines on my forehead though. So I would say 3 out of 4 is not bad. I will keep using this cream and I am sure I will see more improvement on the fine lines on my forehead. I will definitely purchase this product in the future and I highly recommend it.
